description: Decisive reframing of the g₂ chase: the bar-even coefficient g₂ = (E_AME/E⁺ − 1)/h² (#4158 Magnus definition; E⁺=E_rot/(1−t), all pure theory except the MEASURED E_AME) is an AFFINE image of the deuteron binding, with amplification E_AME/(E⁺·h²) ≈ 23.9 (Lean-proved, BindingResidualAmplification). Reproduces the corpus g₂ = 1.00865 exactly. So r = g₂−1 ≈ +0.87% is the binding residual magnified ~24× by 1/h²: deriving r ≡ predicting B(deuteron) to ~36 ppm (~2540× tighter than the current −9.21% accuracy; finer than the tabulated E_rot's 1e-4 MeV precision, which already moves r by 2.3%). r is NOT a separable special-function puzzle — it IS the Δ_λ deuteron-binding closure viewed through a 1/h² magnifier, which quantifies the §2e entropy warning and explains why every amplitude gives the derived leading g₂≈1 but never the residual. Recommendation: pause the g₂/r chase. scope-(a), audit-only, nothing wired; no fit, no AME inversion.
tier: exact affine/amplification structure (Lean-proved) + precision-requirement derivation; reproduces corpus g₂; no fit

B_amplification_and_precision.meaning: g₂ is AFFINE in the measured binding (E⁺,h pure theory); the 1/h² magnifies B's relative error ~24×. Deriving r ≡ predicting B(deuteron) to ~36 ppm.

C_tabulated_input_floor.meaning: a 1e-4 MeV display rounding of E_rot moves g₂ by 2.3% of r — r lives below the noise floor of the tabulated theory input.

verdict.classification: scope-(a), decisive reframing: r is NOT a separable special-function target. Deriving r ≡ predicting the deuteron binding to ~36 ppm, i.e. r IS the Δ_λ deuteron-binding closure (Track A blocker) magnified by 1/h².
verdict.why_amplitudes_give_1: every categorical amplitude reproduces the DERIVED leading g₂≈1; the residual r is the still-open binding, unreachable at 36 ppm.
verdict.entropy_2e_quantified: a ~36 ppm target carries ~zero fit-information — the four-session g₂ chase was chasing a magnified image of the unclosed binding.
verdict.recommendation: pause the g₂/r chase; bank g₂_leading=1 (derived); r reduces to the general Δ_λ closure at a precision far beyond current reach.
verdict.no_ame_inversion: E_AME is the measured target r is DEFINED against (corpus g₂ definition), not a fitted parameter.

context.axis: Δ_λ binding — μ₀ −9% closure, the exact residual r = g₂ − 1
